part.name: ESP32-C3 Super Mini
part.imax_basis: ESP32-C3 chip: vmax is the absolute maximum on the input power pins; imax is the absolute maximum cumulative IO output current, all pins (a whole-chip total, unlike the per-part imax elsewhere); the per-pin limit is UNCONFIRMED and the 40 mA typical is in i_typ. The board's 3V3 regulator rating and 5 V pin path are UNCONFIRMED
part.i_typ_basis: typical source current per GPIO (IOH at PAD_DRIVER 3; IOL sink 28 mA typ), not a limit

part.name: PN532 NFC module, I2C mode (0x24)
part.use: tag reader, VCC to 3V3, IRQ and RSTO unconnected
part.imax_basis: operating maximum, Table 1; Table 13 gives no supply-current limit (PN532/C1 short form data sheet Rev. 1.2; vmax is the Table 13 VBAT limit, 6.0 V). The module's path from VCC to VBAT and PVDD is UNCONFIRMED; fed from 3V3, VCC is under the VBAT 6.0 V limit, and under the PVDD 4 V limit if VCC also reaches PVDD
part.i_typ_basis: IVBAT continuous total current, 91 mA typical (short form data sheet Rev. 1.2, Table 1, 40 ohm typical TX load); a data sheet figure, not a measurement

part.name: SSD1306 OLED module, 128x64, I2C 0x3C
part.imax_basis: SSD1306: vmax is the VDD absolute maximum. The datasheet gives no current limit
part.i_typ_basis: an SSD1306 module draws roughly 10 to 20 mA from 3V3: an estimate, UNCONFIRMED

part.name: rotary encoder with push switch, KY-040 style (type UNCONFIRMED)
part.use: slot and printer knob: A and B to GPIO 3 and 4, common to G, switch between GPIO 1 and 3V3

part.name: 3-pin buzzer module, low-level trigger (active-low), VCC S GND
part.use: beeps and speech, VCC to 3V3, S low = on
part.imax_basis: no datasheet for the 3-pin buzzer module
